talents.name: Wilderness Blessing
talents.description: Extra Movement Speed in Jungle and River. Movement Speed in the Jungle and Rive is increased by 10%. This bonus is halved when in combat wih enemy heroes, Lord or Turtle

talents.name: Seasoned Hunter
talents.description: Increase Jungling Speed. Damage against Lord and Turtle is increased by 15%. This bonus is halved against regular Creeps and doesn't affect the damage of Retribution.

talents.name: Impure Rage
talents.description: Extra Skill Damage & Restore Mana on Hit. Dealing damage with skills deals 4% of target's Max HP extra Adaptive Damage and restores 2% Mana on hit. If the hero does not use Mana restores 1% HP instead. Cooldown: 5s.

talents.name: Quantum Charge
talents.description: Basic Attacks Grant HP Regen & Speed Up. Dealing damage with Basic Attacks increases Movement Speed by 30% for 1.5s and restores 75-180HP (scales with level). Cooldown: 8s.

talents.name: War Cry
talents.description: Increase Sustained Damage. After every 3 Separate Basic Attacks or skill hit an enemy hero, all damage dealt increases by 8% for 6s. Cooldown: 6s.

talents.name: Temporal Reign
talents.description: Non-Ultimate Skills Cooldown Reduction. The next Ultimate cast decreases other active skills' remaining cooldowns by 1.5 times within 4s. Cooldown: 20s.

talents.name: Tenacity
talents.description: Increase Defense at Low HP. When HP is below 50%, Physical & Magic Defense are increased by 15

talents.name: Concussive Blast
talents.description: HP-Based AOE Damage. After the next Basic Attack, deal 100(+7% Total HP) Magic Damage to nearby enemies. Cooldown: 15s

talents.name: Master Assassin
talents.description: Increase Damage to Lone Heroes. If there is only one enemy hero nearby, damage dealt to them is increased by 7%

talents.name: Killing Spree
talents.description: Regen and Speed Up After Kill. After killing an enemy hero, instantly recover 15% of Lost HP and gain 20% Movement Speed. Duration: 3s

talents.name: Festival of Blood
talents.description: Get Extra Spell Vamp. Gain 6% Spell Vamp. Each hero kill or assist grant an additional 0.5% Spell Vamp, up to 8 stacks

talents.name: Brave Smite
talents.description: Skill Damage Grants HP Regen. Dealing skill damage to an enemy hero recovers 5% Max HP. Cooldown: 6s.

talents.name: Bargain Hunter
talents.description: Reduce Equipment Cost. Equipment can be purchased at 95% of their base price.

talents.name: Lethal Ignition
talents.description: Extra Damage on Multi-Hits. Dealing damage greater than 7% of an enemy hero's Max HP 3 times within 5s will scorch the target for Adaptive Damage. Cooldown: 15s.
